IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with
shoulder-length auburn waves and blunt
bangs stands in a warm beige room.
She wears a black cropped long-sleeve
knit with a white ribbed bib panel, a
black satin bow at the neck, and black
feather-trimmed cuffs. A black knit maxi
skirt with a white ribbed waistband
completes the look. Her expression is
calm, with a soft smile. Warm, even
interior light. Palette of black, white, and
warm auburn. Elegant and playful, in the
style of a retro knitwear editorial.
